questions.question: The company’s recent financial *repositioning* has been met with mixed reviews, as some analysts argue it shifts focus away from core products. What word best fits in the blank?

During the *cold shoulder* phase of negotiations, the opposing team’s representatives avoided direct contact, instead sending only vague emails. This tactic was later revealed to be a deliberate strategy to weaken their position. What does *cold shoulder* mean here?
options: a sudden, unexpected withdrawal of support
a formal, official withdrawal from a discussion
a passive-aggressive refusal to engage in conversation
a temporary but friendly pause in communication
questions.answer: a sudden, unexpected withdrawal of support

questions.question: The study’s *substantive* findings were groundbreaking, though the methodology lacked rigorous controls. What does *substantive* refer to in this context?
After years of *operational inefficiencies*, the department was forced to implement sweeping changes to improve productivity. Which word best describes the *operational inefficiencies*?

The *paradigm shift* in digital marketing has transformed how businesses engage with consumers, requiring companies to adapt their strategies or risk falling behind. What does *paradigm shift* mean here?
options: a minor tweak in marketing techniques
a complete overhaul of traditional advertising methods
a gradual but steady increase in online engagement
a temporary phase of experimentation with new tools
questions.answer: a complete overhaul of traditional advertising methods
